Shehnaaz Gill Recalls Mahhi Vij's Past Help During Bigg Boss 13

Actress Shehnaaz Gill has spoken about receiving help from fellow television personality Mahhi Vij during her time on Bigg Boss 13. Gill recalled that Vij assisted her when she lacked basic necessities, stating, "When I didn't have clothes..." The incident was brought up in the context of Bigg Boss 20.
